profile.headline: Senior Full Stack Software Developer | .NET / C# | ASP.NET Core | Angular | JavaScript | SQL Server | Azure | AI-Assisted Development
profile.summary:
I am a Computer Science Engineer and Full Stack Software Developer with 15+ years of professional experience designing, developing, maintaining, and optimizing web applications and Windows Forms applications.

My expertise covers both back-end and front-end development, with a strong focus on the Microsoft .NET ecosystem, application architecture, API development, database design, and delivering reliable, scalable, and user-friendly software solutions.

Technical Skills & Expertise:

.Back-End Development: C#, .NET, .NET Core, ASP.NET, ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Core, Web API, RESTful APIs, Web Services, and Express.js.
.Front-End Development: JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular, jQuery, HTML5, CSS3, and responsive UI development.
.Database Development: Microsoft SQL Server, relational database design, SQL, stored procedures, query optimization, and data management.
.Software Engineering: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), SOLID principles, software design patterns, application architecture, debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
.Cloud & DevOps: Microsoft Azure, cloud-based application development, Git, version control, and CI/CD concepts.
.AI-Assisted Development: Experience leveraging AI-powered tools such as ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot to  improve development productivity, accelerate code generation, assist with debugging, refactor code, and explore technical solutions.

Throughout my career, I have participated in the complete software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis and database design to development, testing, deployment, maintenance, and production support.

I also have one year of experience teaching Computer Science at a vocational school, which strengthened my communication, mentoring, and problem-solving skills.

I am passionate about technology, continuous learning, software quality, and building applications that deliver meaningful value to users. I enjoy collaborating with cross-functional teams, working in Agile/Scrum environments, tackling complex technical challenges, and learning new technologies.

I am currently open to new opportunities, including full-time permanent positions and long-term contract opportunities, where I can contribute my experience, technical skills, and commitment to delivering high-quality software solutions.
